name: Clip a video with ClipForge
tagline: Turn one long video into short captioned clips
blurb: App Hub's ClipForge downloads the video, transcribes it, picks the best moments and renders vertical clips with captions, a hook title and HyperFrames graphics. The best clips are copied into your agent's folder. Needs App Hub open and its connector added.

params.label: YouTube link or full path of a video file
How many clips to hand over

task: Use the App Hub connector (tools named mcp__apphub__...). Make exactly ONE call to mcp__apphub__clipforge_make_clips with input "{video}", wait_minutes 9, skip_if_done true, send_to_starnet "agent" and best {count}. Do not call any other App Hub tool and never start the same video twice. Then reply with: the video title and id, and each returned clip best first (hook title, length in seconds, score, and its starnet.files path). If a file is marked over 20 MB, say it is too big for Telegram. If the status is not done, give the video id and say it is still working; if it is an error, quote the error exactly.
